BiblicalUsage: Gibbethon is a place in Palestine, named 5 times in Scripture, in Joshua and 1 Kings. The full story of the place lives in the Bible itself, and this study covers only the name’s use.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Gibbethon matters because God met His people in real places, not in abstractions. I hold that Gibbethon is worth knowing by name, even when the Bible says little about it.
